content: No templates found with those criteria. Maybe need different criteria. Could search by functional groups formed/broken. Diels-Alder forms a cyclohexene ring, breaks a double bond in dienophile (C=C) and a diene (C=C). So functional groups broken: "C=C". Formed: "C-C". Let's try search with functional_groups_broken ["C=C"] and functional_groups_formed ["C-C"].
